outputs.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: photorealistic reference sheet for a Blender prop in a Korean apartment horror game.
Input image 1 is a REAL photographed Korean EBS32Fb-style molded-case earth leakage breaker; use its physical construction, not its brand.
Primary request: produce one sober, realistic four-view modeling reference sheet. Large straight-on front and large three-quarter views of the same plain older Korean wall-mounted branch distribution panel, plus enlarged front and side views of one individual breaker and its hinge-mounted operating handle.
Panel: closed pale gray painted metal safety dead-front enclosure 36 cm wide, 54 cm high, 6 cm deep, six exposed breaker faces in two columns and three rows, otherwise neatly covered terminals and wires. Each breaker face approximately 5 cm wide and 9.6 cm tall. Modest blank white adhesive circuit-name strips below each unit; one lower spare opening is covered with an ivory blanking plate. Thin perimeter seam, small concealed hinges, small slotted latch. Installed in an ordinary maintained Korean villa, with only light edge wear. No rust story or invented clutter.
Breaker: preserve image 1's layered warm ivory face and gray molded plastic case, narrow dark central vertical toggle recess, genuinely small pivoting gray-black ribbed toggle, round yellow test button. Toggle handle protrudes approximately 1 cm rather than a giant cubic block. Side view must reveal the toggle hinge and modest depth. Neutral white studio background and soft diffuse light; realistic restrained plastic roughness and painted steel. Consistent proportions in all views.
No logos, no readable words, no fake Korean, no dramatic light, no blood, no distressed grunge, no decorative wiring. All circuit-name strips blank because exact Korean typography will be authored separately in the game pipeline. This is modeling reference art, not a screenshot of a game.

note: 판매 사진은 형태 참고에만 사용했다. 생성 시트의 함체와 실물 차단기의 구조를 대조해 모델링하고, 한글 표기는 별도 원본으로 제작했다.
